newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Eleven babies die in Brazilian hospital.
newsitem.headline: Eleven babies die in Brazilian hospital.

text.p: Eleven babies have died in the past 15 days at a hospital in Niteroi, Rio de Janeiro state, the hospital's medical director said on Wednesday.
Marco Antonio Gomes Andrade said 11 babies died due to a bacterial infection and another 25 babies were still infected and currently being treated with antibiotics.
Andrade blamed the overcrowded conditions at the Antonio Pedro hospital for the deaths.

"Overcrowding was certainly a factor which contributed to this problem," he said. "We have space for 20 babies, but we are taking care of 40. Overcrowding is not just a problem at this hospital but a general problem in the health system."
Only last month, 20 babies died of an infection caused by poor hygiene at a maternity hospital in Boa Vista in northern Brazil near the border with Venezuela.
